variables.GlobalParameters.ForceRedoBenchmarkProbl: z3.Bool - public boolean input (YAML GlobalParameters / --global-parameters CLI; default True)
variables.filesystem_results_csv_exists: z3.Bool - ABSTRACTION of the runtime probe os.path.exists(newResultsFileName); free boolean, not solver-derivable from public inputs alone
variables.GlobalParameters.CSVExportWinner: z3.Bool - present in seeded domain; only selects the _CSVWinner filename suffix, does NOT enter the predicate truth value

assumptions: filesystem_results_csv_exists is modeled as a free boolean standing in for os.path.exists(newResultsFileName). Its concrete value is determined at runtime by (a) CLI OutputPath, (b) YAML BenchmarkProblems problem-type name + enumerate idx, (c) YAML CSVExportWinner suffix, and (d) whether a prior run wrote that CSV. It is NOT a pure function of public inputs, hence under-assumptions.

Python or/not over total booleans modeled as classical Or/Not. Short-circuit semantics do not change the truth value of the total expression; when ForceRedo is True the os.path.exists call is never evaluated at runtime, but the modeled truth value is identical.

true_examples._meta: z3-proven. Arm 2 satisfies: results CSV absent -> not os.path.exists(...) is True -> benchmark (re)runs. Minimal witness with Force off.
z3-proven. Default-config witness: Force=True (the GlobalParameters.py default) short-circuits the Or; benchmark always runs regardless of CSV presence.

false_examples._meta: z3-proven. The ONLY falsifying region: Force must be off AND the results CSV must already exist on disk -> skip (already benchmarked). Reachable only after a prior run produced the CSV and ForceRedoBenchmarkProblems was overridden to False via YAML/CLI.

pure_helper:
def force_redo_or_missing(force_redo: bool, results_csv_exists: bool) -> bool:
    """Pure model of BenchmarkProblems.py:740 predicate.
    P = globalParameters['ForceRedoBenchmarkProblems'] or not os.path.exists(newResultsFileName)
    'results_csv_exists' abstracts the os.path.exists filesystem probe.
    post: __return__ == (force_redo or (not results_csv_exists))
    """
    return force_redo or (not results_csv_exists)

crosshair.caveat: CrossHair absence-of-counterexample is NOT a formal proof. Helper is total over 2 booleans; contract is trivially consistent with the z3 truth table.

notes: Two-arm short-circuit Or. Arm 1 (ForceRedoBenchmarkProblems) is a fully-static public boolean (YAML/CLI, default True). Arm 2 (not os.path.exists(newResultsFileName)) is a genuine filesystem probe whose value is external runtime state, abstracted here as a free boolean. Because the overall predicate is decidable once that probe is treated as a seeded boolean, this is solver-backed-under-assumptions rather than fully-static: the FALSE region (Force=False AND file-exists) cannot be reached from public inputs alone without a prior run having written the CSV to OutputPath/2_BenchmarkData. CSVExportWinner only affects the target filename, never the predicate truth value. No GPU/env-var probes reach this branch.
